terrain.horizontal_resolution: 0.5 m derived ground grid; Minecraft bulk cells 1m with 1/16m microcaps

crooked_road.basis: ~11.7m DataSF ROW width minus two 10ft minimum side corridors yields ~5.6m road; visual/aerial cross-check

stairs.known_step_count: use OSM when supplied; derive local count from LiDAR drop for unmapped counts

landscape.source: OSM hedge geometry + DataSF ROW remainder
landscape.first_pass: terrain/hedge masses only; no invented flower-by-flower placement

intersections.Hyde: include street surface and cable-car rails

buildings: No building geometry in L1; footprints shown only in previews/source truth.
